title: A folded note under your door
author: A friend below
notes: The first friend-below note (bible 4.1 beat 4): found under the player's door; Hale delivered it asleep, so nothing here says how it came (his boots reveal stays in hale-watch.json). Re-read after the reveal: 'I will guide you', 'the beast', and the claim to be a friend.

pages.text:
The beast keeps them in the dark. Come down and I will guide you. I have walked these ways a long while and I do not like to see good people lost in them.

— A friend below.
